name: variants
description: Sites with an ALT or mixed call, plus frameshift events (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.5.2, §7.5.5, §9.3).

fields.name: variant_id
fields.description: Variant identifier, numbered from 1 in table order

fields.name: contig
fields.description: Replicon name (C1 order)

fields.name: codon_start
fields.description: Lowest coordinate of the site's first codon in peptide order, 1-based, within [1, length]

fields.name: strand
fields.description: Strand of the peptides' reading frame

fields.name: gene
fields.description: Locus tag of the same-strand gene framing the codon

fields.name: aa_pos
fields.description: 1-based residue position of the codon in the gene

fields.name: ref_codon
fields.description: Gene-strand bases of the codon(s) the REF allele spans (6 nt for two-codon events); for a frameshift, the last prefix codon

fields.name: ref_aa
fields.description: Reference residue of the first codon

fields.name: alt_aa
fields.description: ALT residue(s) (J = I or L); fs+1 or fs-1 for a frameshift

fields.name: alt_type
fields.description: Kind of ALT

fields.name: call
fields.description: Site call

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: high: at least variants.high_min_peptides distinct ALT peptides

fields.name: n_ref
fields.description: Distinct REF peptides at the codon

fields.name: n_alt
fields.description: Distinct peptides supporting this ALT

fields.name: nt_changes
fields.description: Nucleotide changes of the minimal-change ALT codon(s) (G14); NA for unequal-length events

fields.name: alt_codon_vcf
fields.description: Forward-strand ALT allele written to the VCF; NA when not in the VCF

fields.name: class_error_rate
fields.description: Class-specific error rate (%.6g) or unestimated

fields.name: class_error_n
fields.description: Sites behind the class error rate

fields.name: source
fields.description: Semicolon-joined sources of the ALT peptides

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined flags from the Variants vocabulary (§9.4)
